//===== Ragnarok Offline mod: card-remover ===================
//= The Card Remover takes one card out of a piece of equipment the
//= player is wearing, and is paid in cards, not zeny. Every card is
//= worth points by its tier (normal, miniboss, MVP); a removal costs
//= points by the tier of the card removed. All six numbers are the
//= mod's settings. Which cards are MVP and miniboss cards is in
//= card_tiers.txt, generated by scripts/gen-card-tiers.py.
//=
//= Talking to him opens the Card Remover window (client/index.js)
//= with "@@event cardremover open". The window asks through:
//=   @cardremover <id> get
//=   @cardremover <id> remove <equip slot> <card slot> <card id> <payment>
//= <equip slot> is an EQI_* number, <card slot> 0-3, and <payment>
//= is <card id>.<amount>,<card id>.<amount>,...
//= Both answer with the state after the change:
//=   ok|<cost normal>,<miniboss>,<mvp>|<points normal>,<miniboss>,<mvp>|<equipment>|<cards>
//=     <equipment>: <equip slot>:<item id>:<refine>:<card>.<tier>,... (one per item slot) ;...
//=     <cards>:     <card id>.<amount>.<tier>,...
//= or with a refusal the window shows as it is:
//=   err|<message>
//= Answers longer than 200 characters go out in parts (@@reply n k/N).
//=
//= The removal itself is successremovecards with a card slot, from
//= the rAthena fork: it takes the card out in place and the item stays
//= equipped. Requests are only answered near a Card Remover.
//============================================================

// The Card Remover. Placed by the duplicates below; 19510 is drawn as
// data/sprite/npc/vadon.spr (System/jobname.lub).
-	script	Card Remover::CardRemover	-1,{
	mes "[Card Remover]";
	mes "A card stuck in your gear? I can";
	mes "pry it loose. The equipment stays";
	mes "in one piece, and so does the card.";
	next;
	mes "[Card Remover]";
	mes "But I don't take zeny. I take ^0055FFcards^000000.";
	mes "A normal card is worth " + callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "points", 0) + ", a miniboss";
	mes "card " + callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "points", 1) + " and an MVP card " + callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "points", 2) + ".";
	mes "Freeing a normal card costs " + callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "cost", 0) + ",";
	mes "a miniboss card " + callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "cost", 1) + ", an MVP card " + callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "cost", 2) + ".";
	next;
	if (select("Remove a card:Cancel") == 2) {
		mes "[Card Remover]";
		mes "Come back when something's stuck.";
		close;
	}
	@cardremover_npc$ = strnpcinfo(0);
	close2;
	dispbottom "@@event cardremover open";
	end;
}

prontera,182,216,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#prt	19510
geffen,115,73,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#gef	19510
alberta,104,61,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#alb	19510
morocc,155,64,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#moc	19510
payon,166,99,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#pay	19510
izlude,119,157,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#izl	19510
aldebaran,160,100,4	duplicate(CardRemover)	Card Remover#alde	19510

// getarg(0): "points" or "cost"; getarg(1): the tier, 0 normal, 1 miniboss, 2 MVP.
function	script	F_CardRemoverPrice	{
	.@tier = getarg(1);
	if (getarg(0) == "points")
		return callfunc("F_ModSetting", "card-remover", (.@tier == 2 ? "points_mvp" : .@tier == 1 ? "points_miniboss" : "points_normal"), (.@tier == 2 ? 15 : .@tier == 1 ? 5 : 1));
	return callfunc("F_ModSetting", "card-remover", (.@tier == 2 ? "cost_mvp" : .@tier == 1 ? "cost_miniboss" : "cost_normal"), (.@tier == 2 ? 20 : .@tier == 1 ? 10 : 3));
}

-	script	cardremover#mod	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	// The equipment slots a card can be removed from, and the position
	// bit of each, in the order an item that covers several is listed
	// under (a two-handed weapon under the right hand).
	setarray .eqi[0], EQI_HEAD_TOP, EQI_HEAD_MID, EQI_HEAD_LOW, EQI_ARMOR, EQI_HAND_R, EQI_HAND_L, EQI_GARMENT, EQI_SHOES, EQI_ACC_L, EQI_ACC_R;
	setarray .eqp[0], EQP_HEAD_TOP, EQP_HEAD_MID, EQP_HEAD_LOW, EQP_ARMOR, EQP_HAND_R, EQP_HAND_L, EQP_GARMENT, EQP_SHOES, EQP_ACC_L, EQP_ACC_R;
	for (.@t = 0; .@t < 3; .@t++) {
		.points[.@t] = max(1, callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "points", .@t));
		.cost[.@t] = max(1, callfunc("F_CardRemoverPrice", "cost", .@t));
	}
	// Everyone may ask (level 0); the answers are about the player's own items.
	bindatcmd "cardremover", strnpcinfo(3) + "::OnQuery", 0, 99;
	end;

OnQuery:
	.@request$ = .@atcmd_parameters$[0];
	.@action$ = .@atcmd_parameters$[1];

	if (!callsub(S_Near)) {
		callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|Talk to a Card Remover first, and stay near him.";
		end;
	}

	if (.@action$ == "remove") {
		.@slot_eqi = atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[2]);
		.@card_slot = atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[3]);
		.@card = atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[4]);
		.@payment$ = .@atcmd_parameters$[5];

		if (inarray(.eqi[0], .@slot_eqi) < 0 || !getequipisequiped(.@slot_eqi)) {
			callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|You are not wearing that any more.";
			end;
		}
		.@item = getequipid(.@slot_eqi);
		.@card0 = getequipcardid(.@slot_eqi, 0);
		if (.@card0 == 255 || .@card0 == 254 || .@card0 == 256 || .@card_slot < 0 || .@card_slot >= getiteminfo(.@item, ITEMINFO_SLOT)
		 || .@card <= 0 || getequipcardid(.@slot_eqi, .@card_slot) != .@card || getiteminfo(.@card, ITEMINFO_TYPE) != IT_CARD) {
			callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|That card is no longer in that slot.";
			end;
		}
		.@cost = .cost[callsub(S_Tier, .@card)];

		// The payment: cards from the inventory, each kind once.
		explode(.@entry$, .@payment$, ",");
		.@parts = getarraysize(.@entry$);
		.@kinds = 0;
		.@offered = 0;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@parts; .@i++) {
			if (.@entry$[.@i] == "")
				continue;
			deletearray .@pair$;
			explode(.@pair$, .@entry$[.@i], ".");
			.@id = atoi(.@pair$[0]);
			.@amount = atoi(.@pair$[1]);
			if (.@id <= 0 || .@amount <= 0 || getiteminfo(.@id, ITEMINFO_TYPE) != IT_CARD
			 || (.@kinds > 0 && inarray(.@pay_id[0], .@id) >= 0) || countitem(.@id) < .@amount) {
				callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|You do not have the cards you offered.";
				end;
			}
			.@pay_id[.@kinds] = .@id;
			.@pay_amount[.@kinds] = .@amount;
			.@kinds++;
			.@offered += .@amount * .points[callsub(S_Tier, .@id)];
		}
		if (.@offered < .@cost) {
			callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|That is " + .@offered + " points. Removing this card costs " + .@cost + ".";
			end;
		}
		if (!checkweight(.@card, 1)) {
			callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|You cannot carry the card. Make some room first.";
			end;
		}

		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@kinds; .@i++)
			delitem .@pay_id[.@i], .@pay_amount[.@i];
		.@before = countitem(.@card);
		successremovecards .@slot_eqi, .@card_slot;
		if (countitem(.@card) != .@before + 1) {
			// Nothing was removed: give the payment back.
			for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@kinds; .@i++)
				getitem .@pay_id[.@i], .@pay_amount[.@i];
			callsub S_Reply, .@request$, "err|The card would not come out. Your cards were returned.";
			end;
		}
	}

	// The state: prices, the equipment with cards, and the cards to pay with.
	.@line$ = "ok|" + .cost[0] + "," + .cost[1] + "," + .cost[2] + "|" + .points[0] + "," + .points[1] + "," + .points[2] + "|";
	getinventorylist;
	.@listed = 0;
	for (.@e = 0; .@e < getarraysize(.eqi); .@e++) {
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < @inventorylist_count; .@i++) {
			.@pos = @inventorylist_equip[.@i];
			if (!(.@pos & .eqp[.@e]))
				continue;
			// An item covering several slots is listed under the first.
			.@first = 1;
			for (.@k = 0; .@k < .@e; .@k++)
				if (.@pos & .eqp[.@k])
					.@first = 0;
			if (!.@first || @inventorylist_card1[.@i] == 255 || @inventorylist_card1[.@i] == 254 || @inventorylist_card1[.@i] == 256)
				continue;
			.@id = @inventorylist_id[.@i];
			.@slots = min(4, getiteminfo(.@id, ITEMINFO_SLOT));
			setarray .@c[0], @inventorylist_card1[.@i], @inventorylist_card2[.@i], @inventorylist_card3[.@i], @inventorylist_card4[.@i];
			.@has = 0;
			.@cards$ = "";
			for (.@s = 0; .@s < .@slots; .@s++) {
				.@cid = .@c[.@s];
				if (.@cid > 0 && getiteminfo(.@cid, ITEMINFO_TYPE) == IT_CARD) {
					.@has = 1;
					.@cards$ += (.@s ? "," : "") + .@cid + "." + callsub(S_Tier, .@cid);
				} else {
					.@cards$ += (.@s ? "," : "") + "0.0";
				}
			}
			if (.@has) {
				.@line$ += (.@listed ? ";" : "") + .eqi[.@e] + ":" + .@id + ":" + @inventorylist_refine[.@i] + ":" + .@cards$;
				.@listed++;
			}
		}
	}
	.@line$ += "|";
	.@n = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < @inventorylist_count; .@i++) {
		.@id = @inventorylist_id[.@i];
		if (@inventorylist_equip[.@i] || getiteminfo(.@id, ITEMINFO_TYPE) != IT_CARD || (.@n > 0 && inarray(.@seen[0], .@id) >= 0))
			continue;
		.@seen[.@n] = .@id;
		.@line$ += (.@n ? "," : "") + .@id + "." + countitem(.@id) + "." + callsub(S_Tier, .@id);
		.@n++;
	}
	callsub S_Reply, .@request$, .@line$;
	end;

// Is the player near the Card Remover they last talked to?
S_Near:
	if (@cardremover_npc$ == "")
		return 0;
	if (getmapxy(.@pmap$, .@px, .@py, BL_PC) != 0 || getmapxy(.@nmap$, .@nx, .@ny, BL_NPC, @cardremover_npc$) != 0)
		return 0;
	return .@pmap$ == .@nmap$ && distance(.@px, .@py, .@nx, .@ny) <= 14;

// getarg(0): a card's item id. 0 normal, 1 miniboss, 2 MVP.
S_Tier:
	if (inarray($@cardremover_mvp[0], getarg(0)) >= 0)
		return 2;
	if (inarray($@cardremover_mini[0], getarg(0)) >= 0)
		return 1;
	return 0;

// getarg(0): the request's number; getarg(1): the answer.
S_Reply:
	.@request$ = getarg(0);
	.@line$ = getarg(1);
	.@len = getstrlen(.@line$);
	.@parts = (.@len + 199) / 200;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@parts; .@i++)
		dispbottom "@@reply " + .@request$ + " " + (.@i + 1) + "/" + .@parts + " " + substr(.@line$, .@i * 200, min(.@len, (.@i + 1) * 200) - 1);
	return;
}
